title: Experimental visual quantum state discrimination
summary: A learned diffractive optical neural network measurement distinguished visual quantum states with lower error than direct imaging and a single-photon-optimized network. The reported advantage was tested in a noiseless setting and a photon-counting experiment with an electron-multiplying CCD under strong detector noise.
